cards.title: CASTLE STEWARD
cards.concept: castle steward in a plain grey wool tunic with his pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, bare-headed, short dark cropped hair visible, one hand raising a big heavy iron ring of keys at chest height as his only prop
cards.hook: Chief of Staff running internal operations: the one who holds every key to the house

cards.title: GUILD SCRIBE
cards.concept: calm scribe in a grey linen robe with his scarf draped open over his shoulders, bare-headed, holding an open leather ledger and a long quill up at his chest, a lit candle stub behind his shoulder
cards.hook: project management: every plan written down, every deadline tracked

cards.title: QUARTERMASTER
cards.concept: quartermaster in a leather apron over a grey shirt, bare-headed, a thick coil of rope slung over one shoulder and gripped at his chest, his scarf draped open over the other shoulder
cards.hook: operations: the supplies are always there before anyone asks

cards.title: HARBOR CLERK
cards.concept: harbor clerk in a grey buttoned coat with his scarf draped open over his shoulders, bare-headed, raising a warm brass hand lantern beside his face at the quay, a wooden quay post behind his shoulder
cards.hook: operations experience at a Fortune 500 international company: lighting the way for cargo from every port

cards.title: BELL TOWER KEEPER
cards.concept: quiet bell keeper in a grey work coat, hood thrown back and resting on his shoulders, bare-headed, short dark cropped hair visible, scarf draped open over his shoulders, a thick bell rope over one shoulder and a big bronze Campanile bell behind his head
cards.hook: UC Berkeley graduate, the Campanile; keeps the whole team on time with calm steadiness

cards.title: SCOUT
cards.concept: alert scout in a green-lined travel cloak with the hood pushed back off his head, bare-headed, short dark cropped hair visible, his wide pale scarf draped open over his shoulders, a brass spyglass raised at chest height and a green leaf pinned at the cloak clasp
cards.hook: quiet confidence and eyes on everything happening across the company

cards.title: HERALD
cards.concept: herald in a green-trimmed tabard with his scarf draped open over his shoulders, bare-headed, holding a sealed scroll of orders up at his chest, a small grey carrier pigeon perched on his shoulder
cards.hook: Chief of Staff relays the leadership's orders to every team, clearly and on time

cards.title: CARAVAN MASTER
cards.concept: caravan master in a green-accented travel coat with his scarf draped open over his shoulders, bare-headed, holding a folded route map and a large brass compass up beside his face
cards.hook: international operations: moving people and plans across borders without a hitch

cards.title: BEAR CUB WARDEN
cards.concept: forest warden in a mossy green jerkin with his scarf draped open over his shoulders, bare-headed, cradling a small sleepy golden-brown bear cub against his chest
cards.hook: UC Berkeley Golden Bears: the cub that grows into his legendary guardian

cards.title: CHIEF OF STAFF
cards.concept: battle-mage in fitted teal-trimmed robes with his scarf as a mantle over his shoulders, bare-headed, gripping a tall carved staff whose crystal head glows faint teal beside his face
cards.hook: the pun made literal: Chief of Staff, master of the staff

cards.title: CASTELLAN
cards.concept: castellan in teal-trimmed plate livery with his scarf draped over the pauldrons, bare-headed, a gauntleted hand holding a curved war horn hung with a teal banner up at chest height, a crenellated stone wall edge behind his shoulders
cards.hook: keeps the castle running: internal operations as a fortress command

cards.title: RANGER
cards.concept: ranger in dark leather with the hood thrown back onto his shoulders, bare-headed, short dark cropped hair visible, scarf draped open over his shoulders, a teal-fletched longbow over one shoulder and a sharp-eyed hawk perched on the other, faint teal glint on the arrowhead
cards.hook: calm, steady precision: never misses a target or a deadline

cards.title: CLOCKWORK TACTICIAN
cards.concept: grand tactician in ornate violet-and-black robes, bare-headed, natural calm eyes and a level, focused expression, a ring of luminous violet clockwork gears and floating chess pieces orbiting behind his head casting a faint violet rim light on his face
cards.hook: project management at mastery: every moving piece of the company synchronised

cards.title: SHADOW WARDEN
cards.concept: shadow warden in violet-trimmed dark armour with his scarf trailing like smoke, twin glowing violet daggers crossed at his chest, runes drifting in purple mist
cards.hook: quiet operator behind the scenes who simply gets it done

cards.title: GOLDEN BEAR REGENT
cards.concept: regent in radiant gold-and-white regalia with his scarf reborn as a gold-embroidered white stole, holding a blazing golden staff, a colossal spectral golden bear rising behind him under a halo of light
cards.hook: UC Berkeley Golden Bear plus Chief of Staff ascended: the steady hand who rules the realm's operations
